editNotes.basis: The twelve weekly rows are the source of truth and sum to 95 new messages. Removed the obsolete 10-unallocated contradiction from reader-facing copy; weekly targets remain unchanged.

editNotes.details: Friendly worry-to-answer English and Simplified Chinese; natural Chinese dates; removed internal-file prose links and production/research process prose; preserved external URLs, source records, access dates, researchDates and sourceArtifact hashes. Added bracketed DeTars planning request and provenance rendering marker.

datePolicy: All cited external URLs have original access date 2026-11-05 explicitly supported by inspected sources.md and the job/source records. This is not a fresh access or availability claim. Publication/data periods are kept separately; undated pages do not inherit an invented publication date. Future 2027 rules and April vacancy availability are unknown.
uncertainties: Information only, not tax or legal advice. Mexican residence/work permission, regime eligibility, other income/equity, portfolio quality, domain skills, current pay and notice are not personally assessed.

Ten dated advertised pages are not ten employers or confirmed funded seats. BXGI levels may share headcount. doola Mexico eligibility is conditional; LATAM/Americas rules do not confirm local contractual arrangements. Recheck every vacancy.

Wikimedia US-only US$116,633–181,243 is not Mexico pay. RevenueCat $205K header leaves currency, period and Mexico treatment unresolved. Undisclosed pay is not evidence of the negotiation estimate. Senior and specialist requirements remain substantive.

Commercial salary methods differ; HireTalent is modeled, HiresLink defaults to Argentina, Revelo is AOR contracting. No design-specific sample counts or separately validated EU-to-Mexico pay distribution. Employer fees and all-in costs are not worker compensation.

Opening ask, contractor uplift, FX stress, channel allocation, time budget, applications/messages, funnel and decision dates are planning judgments, not survey results, submissions made or a hiring promise. No FX conversion or personalised take-home computation.

Retained tax findings are dated, not fresh advice. Historical SAT annual-filing checklist is qualified by RMF 2026 RESICO-only relief and transition. Other categories and IVA require separate review; export zero rate is not automatic. Original amendment review was targeted, statutory consolidated PDFs timed out, and no detailed bracket/personal calculation was completed.
editingContract: Readable bilingual local drafts only, with matching full literals on corresponding lines and table cells. Preserve stage2-root relative evidence links. No stars, review markup, website integration or publishing.
